candidates.title: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2
candidates.summary: Anthropic released two access tiers of the same frontier model, lowered standard pricing to $8 per million input and $40 per million output tokens, and published first-party coding, science, robotics and safety evaluations.
candidates.what_changed: Fable 5.2 is broadly available with cyber and biology safeguards; Mythos 5.2 exposes higher-risk capabilities through verification programs, while an optional fast mode trades a doubled token price for up to 2.5x faster generation.
candidates.why_it_matters: The release couples a material capability and pricing change with explicit access segmentation, giving engineers concrete model-routing and governance decisions.
candidates.engineer_takeaway: Benchmark Fable at comparable effort and total task cost, and treat vendor evaluations and access controls as evidence to inspect rather than independent proof.

evidence.rationale: Anthropic documents availability, pricing, benchmarks, access tiers and system-card links.
evidence.independent_validation: No independent full-suite reproduction was identified in the bounded pass.
evidence.claim_scope: Availability and pricing are first-party facts; performance, safety and deployment examples remain vendor-reported.

signal.rationale: A major model release changes capability, access, latency and price trade-offs.

deduplication.canonical_event: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 with new pricing and access tiers.
deduplication.previous_coverage: No exact URL, model name or matching release event was found on pinned main or the finalized 6–8 November ledgers.
deduplication.material_delta: A new model generation, pricing surface and verified-access tier became available.

candidates.title: OpenAI discloses a fail-closed kill switch for research inference
candidates.summary: OpenAI described Control Room, a deployed authorization layer that makes research inference engines check a central job state before every model-output request and can halt output within 35 seconds of an intervention decision.
candidates.what_changed: OpenAI published the architecture, fail-closed behavior, safety-case binding and reliability design of its internal research-workload stop system.
candidates.why_it_matters: It turns emergency shutdown from an application convention into a separate inference authorization control that can survive workload failure.
candidates.engineer_takeaway: Bind high-risk jobs to explicit approvals, enforce stop decisions at the inference boundary, and design the controller to fail closed without becoming an untested single point of failure.

evidence.rationale: OpenAI documents the deployed architecture, request path, fail-closed mode and measured intervention latency.
evidence.independent_validation: The internal system was not independently audited.
evidence.claim_scope: The design and first-party latency report apply to OpenAI research infrastructure, not arbitrary serving stacks.

signal.rationale: The architecture addresses containment of long-running, high-risk model workloads at the inference boundary.

deduplication.canonical_event: OpenAI publishes the deployed Control Room architecture.
deduplication.previous_coverage: No exact URL or matching centralized research-inference stop-control event was found on pinned main.
deduplication.material_delta: A previously internal safety control and its architecture were disclosed.

candidates.title: OpenAI and Upwork measure how freelance demand is shifting around AI
candidates.summary: OpenAI and Upwork compared ChatGPT task activity with marketplace postings, reporting that 43 of 63 analyzed work categories moved in the expected opposite direction while AI-related projects combined more skills and carried larger budgets.
candidates.what_changed: The partners published a new marketplace study with a full report and explicit observation windows rather than relying on anecdotes about job substitution.
candidates.why_it_matters: It supplies early empirical evidence that AI may change task composition and project scope before those shifts appear in economy-wide employment statistics.
candidates.engineer_takeaway: Separate displacement, complementarity and project-scope effects; do not infer causality from platform-share correlations or generalize one marketplace to the labor market.

evidence.rationale: The publication links a full report and documents categories, periods and platform comparisons.
evidence.claim_scope: The observational platform data show association and composition shifts, not causal economy-wide employment effects.

signal.rationale: The study provides concrete labor-demand evidence with large practical stakes and clear limitations.

deduplication.canonical_event: OpenAI and Upwork publish a study of AI-related freelance demand and project scope.
deduplication.previous_coverage: The exact URL search was rate-limited once; entity/event/change review of pinned-main ledgers found no matching OpenAI-Upwork report.
deduplication.material_delta: A new report and dataset-backed analysis were published.

candidates.title: Google AI Edge Gallery adds offline speech input and output
candidates.summary: Google added on-device ASR and TTS to AI Edge Gallery, combining Android system models with cross-platform open-weight speech bundles for offline voice applications.
candidates.what_changed: Developers gained streaming multilingual transcription and low-latency synthesis that can run alongside Gemini Nano or Gemma 4 without a network connection.
candidates.why_it_matters: Voice interfaces can keep raw audio local and remain available offline, but performance and device support vary across the Android and cross-platform paths.
candidates.engineer_takeaway: Test latency, memory, language quality and thermal behavior on target hardware, and preserve a modular fallback between system and open-weight speech models.

evidence.rationale: Google documents APIs, model bundles, reference code and first-party latency/speed figures.
evidence.independent_validation: The device claims were not independently benchmarked in this pass.
evidence.claim_scope: Availability and architecture are established; accuracy, speed and contention figures remain device- and vendor-scoped.

signal.rationale: The release makes a complete offline speech loop available to mobile and cross-platform AI developers.

deduplication.canonical_event: Google adds on-device ASR and TTS to AI Edge Gallery.
deduplication.previous_coverage: No exact URL or matching offline speech-pipeline event was found on pinned main.
deduplication.material_delta: A new developer-facing speech input/output capability became available.

candidates.title: OpenAI turns ChatGPT business discovery into a claimed and agentic channel
candidates.summary: OpenAI launched Business Hub in beta and Business Agents for eligible U.S. ecommerce and online-service businesses, separating verified company data and labeled agent conversations from ordinary ChatGPT answers.
candidates.what_changed: Businesses can claim profiles, update details and feeds, inspect aggregated discovery metrics, and deploy labeled agents that may also be sponsored ad destinations.
candidates.why_it_matters: The change creates a new commercial information and agent surface inside ChatGPT, with consequential boundaries between independent answers, first-party data and paid interaction.
candidates.engineer_takeaway: Treat verification, feed freshness, agent disclosure, privacy thresholds and sponsored routing as separate controls; a claimed profile is not proof that every statement is complete or unbiased.

evidence.rationale: OpenAI documents beta availability, profile verification, feeds, aggregate analytics, agent labeling and sponsored placements.
evidence.independent_validation: No independent audit of discovery ranking or privacy thresholds was identified.
evidence.claim_scope: Product availability and stated separation controls are first-party; ranking effects and business outcomes are unmeasured.

signal.rationale: The release creates a consequential new identity, agent and advertising surface inside a major AI discovery product.

deduplication.canonical_event: OpenAI launches Business Hub beta and Business Agents.
deduplication.previous_coverage: No exact URL or matching business-claim and agent-surface event was found on pinned main.
deduplication.material_delta: A new business identity, analytics and conversational commerce surface launched.

watchlist.title: OpenAI brings caregiver AI workshops to five U.S. cities
watchlist.summary: OpenAI and three caregiver and health organizations launched free practical ChatGPT workshops in five cities.
watchlist.what_changed: A concrete community program began, but no participant outcome or independent evaluation was published.
watchlist.reason: The pilot Curious lane fit is strong, yet the announcement is promotional and outcome-free.
promote_when: Publishable participant evidence, measured navigation/time outcomes, or an independent safety evaluation appears.

watchlist.title: ChatGPT Enterprise enters AWS Marketplace
watchlist.summary: Eligible organizations can procure ChatGPT Enterprise and selected vertical products through AWS Marketplace.
watchlist.what_changed: The procurement channel is new, but no technical product capability or measured adoption result was published.
watchlist.reason: Useful enterprise packaging change, below the selected set's engineering and public-interest signal.
promote_when: A material governance integration, usage control or measured deployment outcome is published.
